NGA.note: INEC's AI governance framework is being finalised for its own use, not a rule or designated authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: INEC's ICT director Lawrence Bayode said the commission limits AI to low-risk uses such as public-query chatbots and logistics planning for election materials.
facts.system: INEC public-query chatbot and logistics planning AI

NGA.note: INEC's chatbot and logistics AI is general administration, not a sector's public system.
Only INEC's own AI governance framework is mentioned, not a national AI strategy.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in the country is stated.

facts.fact: INEC's preliminary voter register lists over 103 million voters after a Continuous Voter Registration drive of over 11 million, with about 1.2 million invalid entries purged by automated biometric (ABIS) checks, per INEC's Lawrence Bayode.

INEC made the preliminary register available online on 26 October 2026, and displayed it at ward centres from 9 to 15 October, for public review with complaints received on missing records and errors.

NGA.note: ABIS checks concern the voter register, not a national ID system.
Nothing stated on local government office connections.
